messages.subject: Campus Drive: Fernbank Foods - Supply Chain Analyst (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Fernbank Foods is hiring Supply Chain Analysts (CTC 8 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, IT, ME | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/fernbankSCA by 11:59 PM, 12 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office

messages.subject: Re: Campus Drive: Fernbank Foods - Supply Chain Analyst (2026 Batch)
messages.body: Update: due to popular demand, the registration deadline for the Fernbank Foods drive has been extended to 11:59 PM, 15 September 2026. All other eligibility criteria remain unchanged.
